senses.sense_definition: The suffering or death of a person who is killed or endures severe pain for refusing to renounce a religious faith or other strongly held belief.

examples.text: The ancient cathedral was built to commemorate the <w>martyrdom</w> of Saint Thomas.
He faced his execution calmly, believing his impending <w>martyrdom</w> would inspire future generations.

senses.sense_definition: A state or period of extreme physical or mental suffering, affliction, or torment.

examples.text: Living with chronic back pain for a decade was a true <w>martyrdom</w> for the retired athlete.
The long, exhausting journey across the frozen desert turned into pure <w>martyrdom</w> for the survivors.
